2026.text:
Skip to the power rankings if you want to skip me bitching, moaning, self flagellating, crying and making excuses and taking minimal accountability for fucking up the draft for 45 minutes*


Well, what a silly and fun goof and hijinks to start the season. Got ya guys!...

In all seriousness. My b. (shouts out Chillindude)

Long story long... the draft order got fucked up when I started the new year and I didn't realize it (obviously). The next twist was that I remembered us discussing as a league that the loser bracket wasn't quite accurate. I wanted to keep it as close to the ESPN way as possible for league history, and also to avoid giving Beef any more ammo to keep bitching about leaving ESPN... if you recall the format of the way we settled things in previous years: round one was 7v8, 9v10, and 11v12. Winners climbed the ladder, losers slid down. Weeks 16 and 17 got added together as one two week final for every placement game. That made it impossible for the 7/8 seeds to finish last, and impossible for the 11/12 seeds to win the bracket.

When the pandemonium hit, I tried to find anywhere in writing where we decided how to handle it....Theres nothing lol...To my best memory, we saw after the first week that it was going to be Kevans and Mitch playing for last place either way, that was the only outcome people cared about at the time, so we let it play out in the Sleeper format with a few tweaks (like the battle for 5/6 and 11/12 being a two week matchup, instead of just the single week 16 game shown on the bracket).

Well, now that everything deleted from the Snap, I had no evidence and no way to reconstruct the draft order I made way back when. Also, fun lil tidbit, I'm on call right now, and while all of this is going down I'm on the phone with a mom trying to schedule her kid to get their tooth taken out today.... while watching the Sleeper/Snap group explode... Hugh demanding his money back and threatening to leave the league, Beef trolling about having CMC, people posting their wrong keepers in the chat.... The motherfucking Askvig curse was in full effect and we were in the trenches. In that moment of desperation my decision was to go the Logan method and just base off last year's Sleeper bracket and keep things as simple as possible.

Correct decision? Who knows. But ball up top.

For anyone curious how the pure ESPN loser bracket would have played out vs the Sleeper one... here it is:

ROUND 1 (week 15, everyone plays, no byes)
• (7) Hugh 95.18 vs (8) Chris Nguyen 120.62 → Chris N. climbs, Hugh falls
• (9) Mitch 102.10 vs (10) Logan 104.53 → Logan climbs, Mitch falls
• (11) Kevans 73.86 vs (12) Malin 126.96 → Malin climbs, Kevans falls

FINALS (weeks 16 + 17 combined)
• 7th place game: Logan 237.26 over Chris N. 145.63
• 9th place game: Hugh 256.95 over Malin 228.10
• 11th place game: Kevans 225.34 over Mitch 212.67

FINAL ORDER: old ESPN model vs what Sleeper gave us
• 7th: Logan (Sleeper: Hugh)
• 8th: Chris Nguyen (Sleeper: Malin)
• 9th: Hugh (Sleeper: Logan)
• 10th: Malin (Sleeper: Chris Nguyen)
• 11th: Kevans (same either way)
• 12th: Mitch (last place in both formats)

Sooooo a little variance in 7th through 10th place. I know I know....this is the end of the world. I dont know if the league can survive this. If anyone wants to leave and get their money back just say the word...And if anyone else wants to be commissioner, by all means have at it. This was a nightmare and the worst night of my life.

Otherwise, I accept my shame and my floggings for this failure. First and foremost I apologize to Peyton...To disrespect him on the anniversary of his passing will never sit right with me...I will be seeking professional help to improve myself, prioritizing my family and our health and planning a sizeable donation to the "Pwoods foundation for kids who got in car crashes and died".

As my peace offering to you all I will buy ONE WENDYS FROSTY for the winner of the league this year. Thank you all for your attention to this matter.

GOING FORWARD (unless people freak out about it)
• We use the Sleeper bracket format, with the 5/6 and 11/12 matchups being two weeks long.
• Whoever takes 5th drafts ahead of 6th, otherwise they're incentivized to lose that 5th place game (we've been doing this for a few years anyway... sorry Brook, you got finessed a little bit this year).
• Doing it this way makes record keeping way easier and still makes sure the 7/8 seeds can't get last since they get the first round bye.
• Biggest difference is it now allows the 11/12 seeds to win the loser bracket and the first pick... but tbh it's the loser bracket and I only care about who gets last down there, which is pretty much the same.





Well now that we have all those silly little things out of the way. How about some power rankings?


1) Malin

My favorite Malin draft of all time! The RB room is stacked with high volume guys like Jeanty, Judkins, Breece, and I like the depth with Washington backing up Jeanty and I think Jonah Coleman could play a ton in Denver. WR room solid too with Chase and Adams and maybe Xavier Worthy doesnt get hurt. Germie should play a lot too. Like the team

2) Hugh

Puka and CeeDee is an insane 1/2 at WR, Hampton and Swift should produce well, JK Dobbins pinky promised he wont get hurt this year so theres that, and I like the Kamara stash.. Are we sure Etienne is the starter there when they are both healthy. Not many WRs on the roster but triple TE galaxy brain tactics are in effect and Kraft and Kincaid should get plenty of targets. If Brian Thomas returns to rookie year levels this team probably wins the league

3) Kevans

Im expecting a crazy year for Gibbs and Dak, Solid WR group and I think some good value with Warren and Hubbard. If Kittle can manage a healthy season things could look good for Kevans

4) Logan

Probably the best keeper value in the league with Bucky and has nice depth throughout. Only 1 QB and 1 TE on the roster when most of the league has more might create some bye week and depth issues there. But overall deep team at RB and WR. Maybe trade for Lamar looms? Hopefully the substation doesnt come for CMC...(it will)

Josh Jacobs- not a good guy

5) Chris

Some fun players at the top with Saquon, Skattebo, Nico Collins. Going to need a lot from Tyson or Lemon this year and idk if they are ready to produce in year one. Both already nursing injuries. Not a huge fan of Jayden Daniels or Darnold as fantasy pieces this year either.

6) Roldan

Not my favorite team in the world. Relying a lot on Love and Price as rookie RBs that are probably in time shares, WR after Amon-Ra is a little icky. Shout out Jalen Coker though

7) Niall

Same QB and TE issue as Logan and might be a little worse at both spots. Bijan is great but the RBs after that have some question marks and everyone seems to think Rhamondre will lose touches sooner rather than later despite what the coaches are saying. Rashee Rice is on washed watch a lil bit and Nabers coming off an ACL may not explode. I like Pierce, Hurst, KC Concep and Luther Burden as some high upside guys though.

8) Grant

Hurts, Achane, Cook is nice at the top but the RB depth is a little bad (Gainwell could be sick) and the WR room is a little thin but I do like Malik Washington, usually hes a return yard demon. If Matthew Golden can take a big jump this team could be decent

9) Sam

Very tough break on the double QB auto draft. But maybe a blessing in disguise? It will take some roster management but he could salvage it. Only 3 RBs on the roster may be a concern and the WR depth is deep but maybe low on upside

10) Brook

Not that this team is horrible...and a Bowers keeper is great value but Im not a Drake Maye believer and Brook went all in on the Pats with Maye, Henderson and AJB. Season comes down to them

11) Eric

Im blacking out this draft from my memory. My brain was scrambled out there. We were seeing ghosts

12) Beef

No surprises here. His running back room is very mid. Receivers after Jefferson are shaky. TE is worst situation in the league. Maybe Marvin Harrison and Kyler save their careers this year and this team makes the playoffs!


Good luck this year. Sorry again for fucking up the draft. Peyton pls forgive me.
